english.notes: Lowest band (CB) of the TOEFL iBT scores the Senate accepts as equivalent to the YTÜ English Proficiency Exam (IYS) for exemption from the compulsory English preparatory programme of 30%/100% English departments; IYS pass mark 60/100. PTE Academic 55 on the same table. IELTS is not listed. TOEFL iBT Home Edition not accepted. Below the bar -> preparatory year, not refusal.

value.description: SAT >= 1100/1600 plus Math >= 550/800 for engineering faculties; ACT >= 24; TR-YÖS >= 450/500; IB >= 30; country diploma minimums (e.g. 6/10) for some national qualifications.

gpa.notes: Test-score threshold (SAT/ACT/TR-YÖS). The same annex also lists prose diploma-grade minimums for some countries (e.g. Spain 'Titulo de Bachiller 10 üzerinden minimum 6 diploma notu'); none is a single published GPA minimum for all applicants. Annex revision date 09.07.2024. Note: the YTÜ admissions page says YÖS by other universities is not accepted, while the registration list asks for a TR-YÖS (ÖSYM) result.

tuition.notes: Published as Fall 35.000,00 TL + Spring 35.000,00 TL = yearly 70.000,00 TL; the yearly total is printed, not computed. 2026-2027 only, not 2027/28. The admissions announcement mislabels the link as 2025-2026.

scholarship_exists.notes: No YTÜ-funded award for international bachelor applicants found; the admissions site lists the government Türkiye Scholarships programme and an 'EU Scholarship' announcement with no readable text.
